_comment: License/entitlement config for the unified chat router. Since there's no login system yet, this represents a single 'current_user' profile — once real authentication exists, this becomes a per-client/per-user lookup instead of one fixed entry. bi_expert is a plain boolean (not licensed yet). implementation_expert and support_expert now carry an 'enabled' flag plus a 'modules' map, so licensing can distinguish 'not authorized for this module' from 'authorized, but this isn't in our documents'. Module keys are filename-based placeholders (financial/inventory/payroll/general) pending the real documentation map.
